_doc: The Lab (U7): one experimental mutator per week on the Lab playlist. A mutator only overrides values the game already reads: 'rules' = keys of data/rules.json (plus protect_reduction from prayers.json) for this match; 'mode' = keys of the mode in data/modes.json; 'loadout' = food_mult (scales main and combo food) and kit (force a bracket kit: melee, ranged, magic, hybrid). The Lab plays the Warlord bracket. rotation is weekly from brackets.json rotation_epoch.

no_wards.name: No Wards
no_wards.desc: Protection prayers are disabled. Pure damage races.
no_wards.source: Community request for a mode with no Protect Prayers.

iron_wards.name: Iron Wards
iron_wards.desc: Wards block 60% of matching damage instead of 30%.
iron_wards.source: A protection-prayer trial run in another game and reverted; here we can measure it.

spec_frenzy.name: Spec Frenzy
spec_frenzy.desc: Special attack energy regenerates twice as fast.

frozen_front.name: Frozen Front
frozen_front.desc: Magic kits only, and freezes last twice as long.

low_rations.name: Low Rations
low_rations.desc: Half the main and combo food.

one_life.name: One Life
one_life.desc: Elimination rules in any mode: one life per round, wipe the other side.
